cards.hint: Recall identification methods mentioned for lab work
cards.quote: including DNA fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses (particularly AIDS), and diagnosis of genetic disorders
cards.stem: Which listed laboratory technique uses DNA made by this copying method?

cards.hint: Think of work that charts genetic material
cards.quote: For example, most mapping techniques in the Human Genome Project (HGP) relied on PCR.
cards.stem: What type of project work was described as relying on this copying method?

cards.hint: Consider the type of lab study needing sample material
cards.quote: Because significant amounts of a sample of DNA are necessary for molecular and genetic analyses
cards.stem: Why are large amounts of sample material needed in this context?

cards.hint: Focus on the size and material described as copied
cards.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a technique used to "amplify" small segments of DNA.
cards.stem: What does this technique copy in order to support lab study?
